verdict.rationale: CAM runs Prarambh, a dedicated legaltech incubator launched in 2019, with a structured 10-stage/12-stage program, defined cohort duration and eligibility criteria, mentorship and beta-testing support, and investor exposure for mature startups — clear documentation of a structured accelerator-style program for startups. Missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration of outcomes and explicit ties to university ecosystems beyond the firm's own incubator.
